description: This file defines the Scope struct and associated methods for building TensorFlow computational graphs in Go. It manages operation properties such as naming, device placement, and control dependencies, and provides functionality to organize operations within nested scopes.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Encapsulates the context and properties for building TensorFlow graphs, including namespace, device placement, and control dependencies.

classes.name: scopeErr
classes.description: Internal struct to manage shared error state across scope derivatives.

methods.name: NewScope
methods.description: Creates a new Scope instance with an empty TensorFlow graph.

methods.name: NewScopeWithGraph
methods.description: Creates a new Scope with a specified existing TensorFlow graph.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.description: Returns the constructed TensorFlow graph and marks the scope as unusable afterward.

methods.name: AddOperation
methods.description: Adds an operation with specified specifications to the graph, applying current scope settings.

methods.name: SubScope
methods.description: Creates a nested scope with a specific namespace.

methods.name: WithControlDependencies
methods.description: Returns a new scope with additional control dependencies for operations.

methods.name: WithDevice
methods.description: Returns a new scope applying device placement restrictions.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns any error encountered during graph construction.

methods.name: UpdateErr
methods.description: Sets an error in the scope when an operation fails to be added.
